summary:
Asteria makes it quick and easy to compare lunar landing sites based on sunlight and visibility of Earth.

Find the right spot at desired time!
details: Asteria allows to quickly find and decide which lunar site would be the best for landing based on the desired time of the mission. User inputs when, the app responds with the grading of the sites which have the greatest Sun exposure and longest connection with Earth.
